decision.question: Fix the two review findings for task pausing, or accept as is?

plain.built: You can now pause a task and pick it up later; the agent saves where it got to and its notes.
plain.found: The review found two problems: one can lose notes, the other is a confusing label.

recommendation.reason: Losing notes is worth a quick fix before this ships; the label can wait.

summary: Fresh reviewer, workspace mode (uncommitted candidate on HEAD 403504d). Verdict: approve with changes. OCR delegate preview: 6 files, all reviewable. tsc passes; tests 312/312. Two findings: 1 medium, 1 low.

findings.title: savePause overwrites notes.md instead of appending
findings.detail: server/pause.ts writes notes.md with flag w, so a second pause replaces the first pause's notes.

plain.description: Pausing the same task twice loses the notes from the first pause.
plain.impact: Anything the agent wrote before the second pause is gone for good.

plain.description: The button to continue a paused task says Unpause instead of Resume.
plain.impact: Slightly odd wording; everything still works.

resolvedFindings.title: Pause leaves the agent running
evidence: Round 2 review verified the cancel call and its test.

plain.description: Pausing a task now really stops its agent.
plain.impact: The agent would keep working while paused.
